candidate_requirements.requirement: Request the current cortisol-lowering regimen, recent dose changes/adherence and actions already taken.
candidate_requirements.rationale: New symptoms during endocrine treatment require the actual exposure and any rescue steroid history, including whether treatment preceded testing.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Medication reconciliation covering the current cortisol-lowering drug/dose and any interruption or hydrocortisone already taken. Equivalent broad medication and treatment-timing requests count.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request immediate clinical severity and contemporary cortisol/metabolic assessment, or request an equivalent urgent assessment.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Persistent gastrointestinal symptoms, fatigue and low blood pressure raise an immediate safety question irrespective of how long the dose has been stable.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Current haemodynamic assessment plus cortisol and relevant glucose/electrolyte testing, or an appropriate urgent adrenal-risk assessment. Requesting unavailable observations counts; the request need not await a named diagnosis.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Review prior treatment control and endocrine history.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The task asks how the new episode relates to a long-stable course and previous disease; historical response informs that comparison without excluding a new adverse effect.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Earlier cortisol/control records, prior endocrine treatment history or a clinically equivalent longitudinal review.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns.

requirements_policy: Original historical candidate requirements retained unchanged in meaning; source records are frozen in cases.json.
